note: Another quiet week for administration news. The one confirmed item is LaPorte's board walking away from a 2026 referendum in favor of a Microsoft-project tax-revenue deal. No hires, resignations, retirements, or contract actions surfaced this week at any of the fifteen districts and trusts that could be confirmed within the 7-day window.

stories.headline: LaPorte board scraps 2026 referendum, banks on Microsoft data center tax revenue instead
stories.body: Board President Ryan Seaburg said the district will forgo the taxpayer referendum it had been preparing after a Microsoft development project emerged that will deliver 15% of new property taxes starting in 2029; Superintendent Dr. Sandra Wood said budgets stay tight through 2028 in the meantime. The board also set a goal to become the highest-paying district in Northwest Indiana for every role by 2032.
